$comment: Backup tiers for Azure VMs. infrastructure/main.bicep creates one policy per tier in every vault, and tests/Vaults.Tests.ps1 checks them. The values are examples. Set them from your own data protection requirements. rpoHours and rtoHours are targets, not measured results. Every tier uses an Enhanced (V2) policy because Standard policies can't back up Trusted Launch VMs, which Azure creates by default.

targets.recoveryMethod: Azure Site Recovery failover (regional); instant restore (logical)

tiers.name: Business-Essential
tiers.label: Business-Essential: internal apps the business needs day to day

targets.recoveryMethod: Cross Region Restore from the paired region

tiers.name: Operational
tiers.label: Operational: supporting services such as file servers, jump boxes, and tooling

targets.recoveryMethod: Cross Region Restore, or rebuild from IaC plus data restore
Rebuild from IaC; restore only if needed
